terms.label: Rest edge
terms.unit: per day more rest than the other side

terms.label: Back-to-back
terms.unit: when the other side played yesterday

terms.label: 3 in 4 nights
terms.unit: when the other side plays its third game in four nights

terms.label: 4 in 5 nights
terms.unit: when the other side plays its fourth game in five nights

terms.label: Back-to-back flying east
terms.unit: when the other side played last night a time zone or more west

terms.label: Back-to-back at altitude
terms.unit: per 1,000 meters the other side climbed since last night's game

terms.label: Travel edge
terms.unit: per 1,000 miles less travel since its last game

terms.label: Players out
terms.unit: per 10 of the other side's missing production (pts+reb+ast+stl+blk-to a game)

terms.label: Time zones from home
terms.unit: per time zone the other side sits east of its own home clock (west negative), less its own

terms.label: Time zones crossed
terms.unit: per time zone the other side has flown east since its last game (west negative), less its own

terms.label: Late by its clock
terms.unit: per hour the start falls past 9 PM by the other side's own home clock, less its own

terms.label: Early by its clock
terms.unit: per hour the start falls before noon by the other side's own home clock, less its own

terms.label: Off a blowout win
terms.unit: when the other side won its last game by a blowout, less its own

terms.label: Off a blowout loss
terms.unit: when the other side lost its last game by a blowout, less its own

terms.label: Games in 7 days
terms.unit: per game more the other side has played in the last seven days, this one counted

terms.label: Long road trip
terms.unit: when the away side is on its fourth road game or more in a row

terms.label: Home stand opener
terms.unit: when the home side is back from a trip (its first home game after it)

terms.label: Officials (home lean)
terms.unit: per point (run, goal) a game the home side has beaten the teams' own margins with this crew

terms.label: Last season's net rating
terms.unit: per 5 points of net rating better last season

terms.label: Back-to-backs (total)
terms.unit: to the total per side that played yesterday

terms.label: Players out (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 10 of production missing on both sides

terms.label: Altitude (total)
terms.unit: to the total at a venue over 1,000 meters

terms.label: Off a blowout win (total)
terms.unit: to the total per side coming off a blowout win

terms.label: Lopsided matchup (total)
terms.unit: to the total per point the model's own expected margin, either way, sits over the usual gap

terms.label: Officials (total)
terms.unit: per point (run, goal) a game its crew has run over what the teams usually score

terms.label: Officials (whistle)
terms.unit: per free throw a game more than average its referees award

terms.label: Last season's pace (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 5 possessions a game more for both sides

terms.label: Last season's ratings (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 5 points of both offenses' and defenses' ratings over average
